description: Shows a registered Open Design artifact, or an exploration's directions side by side, or a fluid master's campaign sheet, to the user inline in the conversation, in hosts that render MCP Apps (Claude Desktop Chat). There the user can switch to Comment mode, click an element and leave a comment, then click "Ask Claude to apply", which posts a message here naming the comment ids; export buttons post a request for export_open_design_artifact (the page never downloads). For an exploration, "Take this one" posts the user's pick; confirm the next step with them before calling choose_open_design_direction. A style-tile exploration also offers "Use as design system", which asks directly for next: "save-design-system". With campaign: true (after export_open_design_artifact with campaignSheet: true) it shows every tile of the master's campaign sheet with its errors; "Fix this piece" posts the tile and its errors here. Every host also gets a text result (title, path, open comments, or the campaign tiles); hosts without MCP Apps are told to use open_open_design_preview. In Claude Desktop Chat call it after register_open_design_artifact and after applying comments. Pass entryPath, or explorationId for an exploration.

campaign.description: With a fluid master's entryPath: show its last campaign sheet, tile by tile, instead of the design.

entryPath.description: Workspace-relative path to the registered artifact's entry file.

explorationId.description: An exploration id from prepare_open_design_exploration, to show its directions instead.

name: show_open_design_artifact
